summary.oneLiner: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd has delivered strong Q4FY26 results, driven by higher sales volumes and improved realizations, and is poised for growth with its expansion plans and increasing demand for protein products.

one-line thesis: SKM Egg Products Export (India) Ltd has delivered strong Q4FY26 results, driven by higher sales volumes and improved realizations, and is poised for growth with its expansion plans and increasing demand for protein products.
financial scorecard: Revenue: ₹767 crores (up 58% YoY), EBITDA: ₹163 crores (up 128% YoY), PAT: ₹102 crores (up 208% YoY), Order Book: Not disclosed, Net Debt: ₹302 crores (increased to fund capex)
guidance: Revenue growth: 10-15% (FY27), Margin expansion: Yes, Order inflow: Steady, Capex/Commissioning: ₹400 crores (for capacity expansion)
segment / subsidiary detail: Egg Powder: 7126 MT (up 15% YoY), Egg Products: Not disclosed
growth verticals / optionality: Increasing demand for protein products, Expansion into new markets (e.g. Japan), Value-added products (e.g. egg white cube, whey protein equivalent)
margins & cost dynamics: Gross Margin: 21% (up 500 bps YoY), Operating Margin: 21% (up 700 bps YoY)
capex / expansion: ₹400 crores (for capacity expansion, including ₹101 crores from internal accruals and ₹302 crores from bank term loan)
risks & watch-items: Bird flu outbreaks, Fluctuations in egg prices, Currency fluctuations
non-obvious takeaways: Company's focus on quality and efficiency has helped it gain a strong reputation in international markets, particularly Japan.

themes.title: Agri value-chain - food processing, dairy, protein & seeds
themes.need: Rising protein/processed-food consumption, animal-nutrition demand and export tailwinds drive an integrated agri value-chain - DODLA/PARAGMILK on dairy; AVANTIFEED/SHINDL/SKMEGGPROD/HMAAGRO on aqua/poultry/meat protein; GODREJAGRO/KSCL/NATHBIOGEN on feed + seeds; REGAAL/SUKHJITS/GULPOLY on maize/starch; FOODSIN/MANORAMA on agri-processing & specialty fats.
themes.driver: Monsoon-led farm income; protein export demand; feed-margin recovery; festive processed-food restocking.
